technique_name: Create an essay on the causes of child obesity.
description: Child obesity has become an increasingly dangerous problem in recent years. One of the major causes is poor diet, especially among young children who are unable to make their own food choices. Unhealthy food is often cheaper, more available, and more appealing than healthy food, making it an attractive choice for parents facing financial pressures. Lack of access to outdoor space and recreational programs can lead to a decrease in exercise and physical activity, leading to increased weight gain.
